description: External wallet signing path — use this instead of passing signing payloads directly to haiku_execute when WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY is not set or when a wallet MCP (Coinbase Payments MCP, wallet-agent, etc.) handles signing. Extracts and normalizes the EIP-712 payloads from a quote into a standard format any wallet's signTypedData can consume. Pass quoteId (preferred) — the server resolves the full quote from session cache. Alternatively pass the full quoteResponse object if quoteId is unavailable. After signing externally, pass permit2Signature and/or userSignature to haiku_execute.

quoteId.description: Quote ID from haiku_get_quote (preferred — server resolves the full quote from session cache)

quoteResponse.description: Full response from haiku_get_quote (fallback when quoteId is unavailable)

name: haiku_prepare_signatures
